alt: Content Sort: the waiting items down the left, newest first, with a working paper chosen; its card on the right shows New research, the Working Paper subtype, Keep and next, Skip for now and Delete.

pins.label: The item the card shows. Pick a row, or move with the up and down arrows
Type: what the item is. Pick one, then its subtype
Keep and next: keeps it and opens the next item. K does the same
Delete: takes it out of the queue. D does the same
